notes: input = encoded argument array (decode with golden.mjs decode: {$undefined}, {$number}, {$date}, {$regexp}, {$utf16}); expected = encoded return value, or {$error:{name,message}}. JS strings are UTF-16: all positions/lengths/indices in inputs and outputs are UTF-16 code-unit offsets; cases with non-BMP/multi-unit strings carry a `utf16` array (utf16_len/scalar_len/utf8_len per such string arg). TZ pinned to UTC for date-based helpers. Date args are {$date}; local time = UTC.
